# fix_time_coord { #wass2s.fix_time_coord }

```python
fix_time_coord(ds, seas)
```

Fix time coordinates by extracting year and assigning a fixed month/day.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                                                | Default    |
|--------|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ds     | xarray.Dataset | Input dataset with time dimension 'T'.                                                     | _required_ |
| seas   | tuple          | Tuple containing season information, where seas[1] is the month (e.g., '11' for November). | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                       |
|--------|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.Dataset | Dataset with updated time coordinates in the format 'YYYY-MM-01'. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Assumes the input dataset's time values can be converted to pandas datetime objects.
